explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 89 named tracks and releases across Juno's 14 September techno pages, same-day Bandcamp releases from Danza Nativa, TSSRCT, Haŵs and Sähkö, adjacent 2026 releases from Vault and Molecular, and overlooked 2013 Perc Trax/Pole Group and February 2026 Planet Rhythm catalogue pages. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, active discussions, revisit queue, rejected state, discoveries, target-local inspiration files and global utility ledger were audited first. No objective defect, active listener authorization, triggered revisit or open workflow repair required REPAIR.

Completed Runs 248-252 were compared before ranking. Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved, duplicate and exact-alternate identities were excluded; the ranking does not recycle Run 252's unresolved artists or placement boundaries.

The top three leads come from current, adjacent-world and overlooked-catalogue windows. Candidate order reflects candidate-specific evidence and information gain rather than novelty, genre status, stylistic diversity or resolver convenience.

Shared release-level framing was used only as lead-floor justification, never as proof of energy, density, hypnosis, emotion, phrase structure, mixability or transition quality. No proposed placement splits either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
Generic tags, artist reputation, buyer comments, release recency and bare titles were insufficient by themselves; Sawa and Carried remain removed and Tender Is The Night remains positively retained.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: BLNDR's Mangrove EP on Danza Nativa, UFO95's Feed manipulation on TSSRCT, Boulderhead's Sunshine on Haŵs and Ø's Röntgen reissue on Sähkö, all released 2026-09-14 and checked 2026-09-14. https://blndr.bandcamp.com/album/mangrove · https://ufo95.bandcamp.com/album/feed-manipulation · https://hawscardiff.bandcamp.com/album/sunshine · https://sahkorecordings.bandcamp.com/album/r-ntgen

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Patient's Rhythm Dancer EP on Vault Records (2026-04-10) and Molecular Recordings' 2026 catalogue, including Covalence Series 2, checked 2026-09-14. https://vaultrecords.bandcamp.com/album/rhythm-dancer-ep · https://moleculartechno.bandcamp.com/album/covalence-series-2

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Perc Trax vs Pole Group Pt.2 (2013), whose label text distinguishes the Pole Group pair's broken-beat/dubbed-atmosphere approach, plus Jon Head's February 2026 Broken Bells EP on Planet Rhythm. https://perctrax.bandcamp.com/album/perc-trax-vs-pole-group-pt-2 · https://planetrhythm.bandcamp.com/album/broken-bells-ep
